mechanism.driver: Pantheon+ and DES-Dovekie official/public products with one versioned nuisance and absolute-magnitude policy
mechanism.trigger: Materialize each calibration variant independently; hash data vectors and covariance; validate dimensions; fit LCDM/CPL/RLL under identical nuisance policy; emit full-covariance and redshift-resolved residual receipts.
mechanism.verification: Provider identifiers/hashes, vector/covariance dimension checks, calibration variant, nuisance policy, full-covariance chi2/loglike and redshift-binned residuals must be present; diagonal-only runs remain exploratory.
mechanism.falsifier: Missing covariance provenance, dimension mismatch, calibration variants mixed silently, different nuisance treatment across models, or diagonal-only evidence blocks closure.

close_when: Pantheon+ and DES-Dovekie calibration variants are separately materialized with immutable provenance
full covariance dimensions match each fitted SN vector
one declared nuisance/absolute-magnitude policy is applied across LCDM/CPL/RLL
full-covariance likelihood and redshift-binned residual receipts are reproducible
diagonal-only output is not used as closure evidence
added_open_mechanisms.claim_boundary: Modern SN likelihood materialization is one probe-level validation component; it cannot by itself establish RLL superiority, resolve H0 tension or authorize publication claims.

invariants: The V1 Modern Validation SN gap is surfaced rather than dropped during reconciliation.
Adding a previously hidden valid gap increases the open denominator; this is improved accounting, not regression.
No scientific claim is promoted by the presence of a mechanism contract.
